data.completion_memo: Fixed the slow filtered loading. Two genuine superlinear algorithms were removed. (1) The older-page loader merged and re-projected the WHOLE accumulated range on every page: `mergeCanonicalEvents` copies+sorts the full array, then `projectSemanticTimeline`+`conversationFeed` ran over the growing set, so one read was O(pages^2 * pageSize). It now classifies each fetched page on its own (O(page)) while accumulating shown ids, and does a single `mergeCanonicalEvents`/`withEventSupport` at publish; the page budget still bounds a read and the target keeps the amount the user approved. (2) `projectSemanticTimeline` had two hot spots: `hasFollowingAssistantMessage(span, ordered)` rescanned every event for every rendered span (O(spans x events) per projection, on every events change including each live stream publish and each prefetch), and streamed deltas used `span.reasoning += append`. The message scan is replaced by one linear pass building a sorted message-kind list plus a binary search per span; deltas are pushed into per-span part arrays and joined once after the loop. `belongsToWindow` is now computed once (`windowSpans`) instead of twice. Added `useOlderChatEvents.test.ts`, which mocks the projection and proves no single projection ever receives more than one page of events and the read is linear in pages (the old code would have fed it the cumulative range). Verified: `pnpm check` clean; `pnpm build` succeeds; `eventWindow.test.tsx` (6) and `useOlderChatEvents.test.ts` (1) pass; the whole `pnpm test:chat` suite (47 files, 299 tests) passes. Note: the native page size stays 128 (hardcoded in ledger/queries.rs), so a filtered read is still up to 24 IPC round-trips; raising it would be the next lever if needed.

lines:
Feature: a filter icon button at the top of the Chat opens a dropdown with a checkbox per entry — `thinking` and `tools`. Unchecked entries are not displayed; toggling must update already-rendered content; with both unchecked only user input and model output remain.
Implementation notes (researched): render pipeline is `timelineItems` (`ChatWorkspaceScreen.tsx:241-244`, must stay unfiltered for the question dialog / Run Details at 932) → `feedItems` (245) → `ConversationTimeline` → `presentTimelineItems` (ConversationTimeline.tsx:65). Classification: standalone reasoning is `kind==="thinking"` (ConversationTimeline.tsx:499); tool/MCP are `kind==="tool"` (523) / `kind==="mcp"` (generic card). Crucially a model-call span with streamed reasoning is rendered by `ModelCallBlock` (255) which contains the reasoning bubble *and* the final assistant answer, so a naive `kind` filter would delete the answer — thread a `hideThinking` prop into `ModelCallBlock` instead and hide only its reasoning bubble. Add the control to `.run-actions` in the Chat header (`ChatWorkspaceScreen.tsx:715`), reusing the `TodoControl` popover pattern (outside-click/Escape close, aria-expanded/controls). No production localStorage exists, so keep the filter in React state (session-scoped).
Verification: extend `ModelCallBlock.test.tsx` / timeline tests for hiding thinking inside a model call and hiding tool rows, and assert the user message + assistant answer remain.

data.title: Add a Chat output filter for reasoning (thinking) and tool entries
